== Summary ==
Slip “•Come Here You Big Coward (Special Edition)” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 75, 1624, 798)). Version [[Come Here You Big Coward (Special Edition) (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
